arrival.queen.alt: A queen with long braids and a green cloak steps from a beached longship onto a timber jetty, shield-bearers lining the shore of a misty fjord at dawn.

capture.knight.bishop.alt: A helmed rider in a red cloak rears his grey horse in the surf before a white-robed seer with a carved crook staff, on a stony shore under a storm.

kingfall.blade.alt: In a smoky mead hall a grey-bearded king in furs kneels in the straw, his gold circlet fallen, as a young warrior in a red cloak stands over him with a sword.

battle.victory.alt: A crowned king in a fur mantle and a queen in a green cloak stand on a headland at sunset as warriors raise their spears and longships sail home below.

battle.defeat.alt: In driving rain a grey-bearded jarl in a fur mantle sits bowed on a rock by the shore, his sword point-down beside him and his banner trampled in the mud, as a longship sails off into the mist and two ravens watch from a fence post.

kingfall.siege.alt: Before the smoking gate of a snowbound timber stockade, a grey-bearded king in furs and a gold circlet kneels and offers up his sword to a chieftain in a red cloak, ringed by warriors with round shields.

capture.alt: On a surf-washed shore under a misty fjord, a warrior in a red tunic charges with his spear raised as a man in dark blue falls to one knee in the waves, his shield held over his head and his spear lost on the stones.

capture.pawn.alt: In a muddy field by a sunlit fjord farm, a barefoot youth in a white tunic, wicker shield up and spear levelled, drives back a mailed warrior in a steel helm who stumbles away.

capture.knight.alt: A rider in a red cloak and iron helm leaps his dappled grey horse over a dry-stone wall on a heather slope above a sunlit fjord, sword raised, as a barefoot youth falls back into the heather with his wicker shield thrown up too late and his spear on the ground.

capture.bishop.alt: On a clifftop under a thunderstorm a white-robed seer with a carved crook staff raises a gale that tears the shield from a warrior in a red cloak and sends it spinning over the sea.

capture.rook.alt: A towering huscarl with a red-quartered round shield and a raised axe plants his foot on a timber palisade by the sea and forces back a warrior in a dark tunic, spearmen crowding behind him at sunset.

capture.queen.alt: A queen with long braids and a green cloak strides along a pebble beach, sword drawn and a shield wall at her back, as a mailed warrior falls sprawling onto the stones before her.

capture.king.alt: Before a carved timber hall in the snow, a grey-bearded king in a great fur cloak and gold crown crosses swords with a young challenger in a white tunic and red sleeves while the household looks on.

capture.pawn.queen.alt: On a plank bridge over a misty birch-wood stream at sunrise, a barefoot youth with a wicker shield thrusts his spear at a startled queen in a green cloak, her red shield raised.

capture.knight.rook.alt: A rider in a red cloak sails over a timber stockade on a leaping grey horse as a broad huscarl below swings his axe up at him behind a painted round shield.

capture.knight.queen.alt: On a fjord shore at sunset a rider in a red cloak gallops past on a grey horse and snatches away a banner, while a queen in a green cloak with long braids lunges after it and her guards run up.

capture.queen.knight.alt: On a windswept moor a queen in a green cloak seizes the bridle of a rearing black horse as its rider in dark blue is dragged down to his knees beside it.

capture.bishop.knight.alt: Among standing stones on a headland under a storm, a white-robed seer raises his hand and crook staff and a black horse rears back in fright, throwing its rider in a dark blue cloak.

capture.rook.pawn.alt: A huge bearded huscarl in a red cloak, axe raised and painted shield on his arm, wades through a river ford as a barefoot youth with a wicker shield and spear reels back into the water.

capture.rook.bishop.alt: On a heather headland beside a tall standing stone, a mailed huscarl in a red cloak, axe on his shoulder and painted round shield on his arm, stands over a white-bearded seer who kneels with bowed head, his carved crook staff lying in the grass.

capture.queen.rook.alt: On a snowy fjord shore at sunset a queen with long braids, a silver circlet and a green cloak holds her sword over a mailed huscarl who kneels with bowed head, his round shield and axe lying in the snow.

arrival.rook.alt: A shield-bearing huscarl with an axe leaps from the dragon prow of a longship into the surf of a rocky shore at sunrise, its mailed crew at the oars and more warriors coming down the misty headland.

arrival.bishop.alt: A white-bearded seer with a carved crook staff steps down from a beached longship between two shield-bearing warriors, ravens wheeling over a headland of standing stones.

arrival.knight.alt: A helmed warrior in a red cloak leads a dappled grey horse splashing ashore beside a plank from a moored longship, in a sunlit fjord ringed by mountains.

ship.embark.alt: Warriors with round shields wade out to a dragon-prowed longship in a mountain fjord at sunrise, while a red-cloaked figure and a helmed rider on a grey horse wait on the timber jetty.

ship.setsail.alt: A longship under a white and crimson striped sail pulls away from the harbour on its oars, watched from the jetty by a woman in a green cloak with a long braid, a boy and a grey-bearded old man.

ship.landing.alt: A dragon-headed longship drives into the surf and warriors leap from it onto a pebble beach, where two startled men with a spear and a red shield turn to face them.

ship.raid.alt: At moonrise raiders pour from a beached longship onto a pale shore and charge a timber palisade gate held by shield-bearing spearmen, as smoke rises from a hall beyond.

ship.raidcheck.alt: A grey-bearded king in a fur cloak and gold crown stands on the steps of his carved hall as a column of shielded warriors marches up the snowy shore from a longship under a stormy sky.

ship.boarded.alt: Two longships grappled together with ropes and chains in a rough sea, warriors with swords and shields leaping the gunwales to fight hand to hand.

ship.seized.alt: Strangers have taken a beached longship at sunset: one climbs the mast to hoist a blue and white striped sail, another stands on deck, and two more watch from the rocks.

ship.lifeboat.alt: Under a black storm sky a crew rows a small longship hard through white-capped waves as the sea closes over a low sandy island behind them.

ship.lost.alt: Lightning splits the sky as a longship with a torn purple-striped sail founders in towering waves, its last crew clinging on at the bow.

ship.emptysunk.alt: An empty dragon-prowed longship settles into a calm fjord at sunset, its striped sail trailing in the water while gulls circle overhead.

ship.newkeel.alt: Under a boatshed roof shipwrights raise the tall curved stem of a new longship on the shore, while a woman holding a lantern looks on and others plane the planks.
